_doc: Per-file slow-motion switches. Looked for as <project>/prep-options.json first, then this file. Clips captured at >= 100 fps play as show.json taste.slow_motion says: "slow" (at 30 fps, like Photos shows them; the default) or "realtime" (real speed). realtime: filenames that play at real speed although the mode is slow. slow: filenames that stay slow although the mode is realtime. Re-run bin/prep --force --only <file> after changing.
